flags.message: Docket 26-118 is a mandatory appeal (jurisdictional statement). The appellees' motion to dismiss (Rule 18.6) and the appellants' response were not staged under record/documents/, though they are the BIO/reply analogues; I fetched both from supremecourt.gov.

Cert-stage base rates (band 'high', cert_anchor 0.348) describe discretionary petitions; on a §1253 appeal the Court must decide the merits, so the grant family (summary reversal / vacatur / noting probable jurisdiction) runs well above the anchor.
